What Equipment Do You Need to Be a YouTuber in 2024?
summary: What equipment you actually need to be a YouTuber, from camera and mic to lighting and software, at every budget.
body_text: So, you're ready to jump into the world of running your own YouTube channel. You're passionate, driven, and ready to climb. It's a great place to be, but it raises one very big question: What gear do I actually need? Trust me, I get it. As someone who's been in the video creation trenches myself, I know the struggle of trying to figure out which equipment is essential and which is just hype. You don't need a Hollywood budget or a fancy studio to create awesome videos. That's why this guide is all about the essentials for small to medium creators like you. We'll focus on gear that delivers bang for your buck for your home studio and helps you connect with your audience without breaking the bank. We'll touch on the core tools you need to get started: cameras, microphones, and lighting . Plus, I'll throw in some bonus tips to help you choose the right gear for your unique style and budget. Camera: Lights, Camera... Awesome Videos! First up, cameras, because you're recording video. Duh. But woah, hold your horses and in no one do you need to (nor should) run out and buy the most expensive DSLR video camera you can find. That's actually the worst thing you can do. To put this bluntly, unless you're aiming to keep your YouTube channel a hobby, you need to treat it as a business from Day One, and this means making smart investment choices. And quite simply, why put all your money into a camera when you can buy a cheaper beginner model or mid-range used camera with acceptable results and invest your savings into your actual video content? So, options. You can; Use your phone (perfectly acceptable since the video works so well A high-quality webcam. Hit and miss because you need a really good one. A camera. The best option, as long as you're spending your money in the right place. Let's go deeper. iPhone Continuity Camera (Low budget, but big impact!) Got an iPhone? Boom, you've got an excellent camera right in your pocket. If you're rocking a newer model iPhone (and a newer MacBook), you can use Apple's Continuity Camera feature to transform your phone into a high-quality webcam. It's also really great for producing Shorts content . The quality is truly amazing – think FaceTime, but even better, beamed directly to your computer. This is the ultimate hack for those just starting, and it won't cost you a dime. That said, you will need a microphone because audio is so important. Viewers are WAY more likely to tune out when you have bad audio. You need quality audio and acceptable video quality, and then scale your equipment as you grow your channel. Sony A6400 (Mid-range, but packs a punch!) If you're looking for a decent DSLR option, the Sony A6400 is fantastic. Released in 2019, this is a mirrorless option that's becoming a favorite among YouTubers. It shoots in stunning 4K, has great build quality, and won't totally break the bank. You're also future-proofing yourself. Instead of buying a real basic camera and wishing you had more when you start getting really good, you stick to the first step and have a camera that'll give you everything you need for the first two to three years. You can buy this used or new anywhere between $400 and $1,200. eBay and Facebook Marketplace are good options here. Sony A7 (High-end, but even more future-proof!) If you're looking for the big guns, either to future proof yourself for up to five years, or you need real quality for your productions (depending on your niche), the Sony A7 delivers. This professional-grade beast is used for filmmaking and photography, so you know it delivers exceptional quality. Despite being released in 2013, it's still over $3,000 new, so it looks preowned. As long as it works, no one's going to know the difference. Extra Bits and Bobs A few more things to consider when choosing your camera: Capture Card/Cam Link: Older Sony camera models might need one to connect to your computer. Don't worry, they're not too expensive. Lens: Want that beautiful blurred background effect? Consider upgrading to a Sigma lens for a more professional look. Tripod/Mount: No one likes shaky footage. Invest in a tripod or mount to keep your camera steady and your videos looking polished. Dummy Battery: If you plan on filming for hours on end, this handy little gadget will keep your camera powered up and prevent any unexpected shutdowns mid-shoot. Microphone: Sound Like a Pro (Even if You're Not!) Here's a hard truth: even if your videos look like a million bucks, bad audio can make them sound like they were recorded in a tin can. Again, viewers are far more forgiving of a slightly imperfect image than cringe-worthy sound. So, get the sound right, and you're onto a winner. Blue Yeti (Entry-level, but sounds amazing!) When I started streaming on Twitch (and sharing vids on YouTube), this was my go-to, and to be honest, it is for a lot of content creators to the point where it's almost a meme. A real crowd-pleaser; even pros still use this. Setup is effortless since you can just plug it in and go, and it's compatible with pretty much any tech you have. The sound quality is also surprisingly good for its price point, which sits around $100 to $150. Again, it's probably cheaper to buy used. Shure SM7B (High-end, the holy grail of audio) As a bit of insight into the top end of video sound, the Shure SM7B is the way forward and is used by so many podcasters , YouTubers, and professional broadcasters. It's the highest of the high and the best of the best. It's recording studio quality in your house. Seriously, go to the Huberman Lab podcast, Diary of a CEO, Joe Rogan, The Mel Robbins Show, and more - they're all using it. New, it's about $500 with the preamp built-in. Oh, and whatever microphone audio set-up you get, make sure you invest wisely and don't invest beyond your means (great gear is nothing if you can't invest in the content itself), and don't the boom or stand. One with a flexible arm can help out a lot. Lighting: Shine Bright Like a Diamond (on a Budget!) The third point of the video creation trinity is lighting. Cameras only work when you have good lighting. Light comes in, bounces off a surface (or you) and into the camera and the camera records what it gets. Recording in a dark and dingy room will result in dark and dingy video content. So, how to get better quality video, even when you're using basic gear? You increase how much light you're working with. Here are some options to consider: Softbox: Your One-Stop Shop for Glowing Skin Don't let the fancy name intimidate you. A softbox is basically a light with a big diffuser that creates a soft, flattering light. It's like having your own personal sunshine on demand! The best part? You can snag one of these for around $50 or even less. I got a kit a few years ago from Amazon for two of these for $25, and they worked amazingly, so shop around. Having a softbox in your setup means you can: Film anytime, anywhere: Say goodbye to those "it's too dark to record" excuses. Look amazing on video calls: Impress your clients and colleagues with your perfectly lit visage. Create a professional vibe: Elevate your videos to the next level with high-quality lighting. Pro Tip: If you're feeling fancy and have a bit more budget, consider investing in multiple lights for a more sophisticated setup. But even with just one softbox, you'll be amazed at the difference it makes! Here's a video that goes into the science of it. That said, simply opening your curtains and letting some natural light in, or filming next to the window, can work absolutely wonders. And with that, you have pretty much everything you need to kick your YouTube journey off in the best possible way. Use some free video editing software like Da Vinci, and you'll be up and running in no time. Additional Tips for Your Video Gear Journey Alright, we've covered the essentials: cameras, microphones, and lighting. But I've got a few more tricks up my sleeve to help you navigate the wild world of video gear: Hack Your Home Lighting Don't underestimate the power of lamps you already have at home! Get creative and experiment with different combinations and placements. You might be surprised at what you can achieve with a little ingenuity. Here are a few tips: Bounce the Light: Place a lamp behind a white sheet or bounce it off a white wall to create a softer, more diffused light. Multiple Light Sources: Use several lamps to create a more even light and eliminate harsh shadows. DIY Diffuser: Cover a lamp with a thin white cloth or parchment paper to soften the light. Embrace the DIY Spirit Not everyone has a wad of cash lying around for top-of-the-line gear, and that's totally okay. Remember, creativity and resourcefulness are a YouTuber's best friends. If you're on a tight budget, try these hacks: Natural Light Is Your Friend: Find a well-lit spot near a window for filming. Just avoid harsh sunlight, as it can create unflattering shadows. Hack Your Lighting: Get creative with lamps you already have at home. Experiment with different placements and angles to create a soft, even light. Free Editing Software FTW: Don't shell out for expensive editing software just yet. There are plenty of free options out there that can get the job done. Choose the Right Gear for You Before you hit that "add to cart" button, take a step back and consider your specific needs: What kind of videos do you create? Different genres might require different types of gear. What's your recording style? Do you sit at a desk, move around, or film outdoors? What's your budget? Be honest with yourself about what you can afford. Do Your Research Don't just blindly follow my recommendations (even though they're pretty awesome, right?). Take the time to research different brands and models. Read reviews, watch comparison videos, and see what other creators in your niche are using. The more informed you are, the better equipped you'll be to make the right choice for your setup. See what options are available to you right now, in your area, and in your budget. Use Free Editing Software: Your Secret Weapon Don't let fancy editing software scare you away. There are plenty of free options out there that are surprisingly powerful and easy to use. Here are a few popular choices: DaVinci Resolve: This professional-grade software is free to use and offers a wide range of editing tools and features. OpenShot: This open-source video editor is simple to use and perfect for beginners. HitFilm Express: This powerful editor offers advanced features like visual effects and compositing. Remember, the best gear is the gear you have. Get creative, be resourceful, and don't let a limited budget hold you back from creating awesome videos! Check out our complete list of video tools for creators here for more! Have Fun and Experiment! At the end of the day, creating videos should be fun. Don't get too caught up in having the "perfect" gear. There's no such thing. There's just the gear you've got to work with. Start with the essentials, experiment with different setups, and, most importantly, have fun expressing your creativity. Conclusion Congrats, you've officially made it to the end of our video gear guide. You're now armed with the knowledge you need to choose the right tools for your YouTube journey. Remember, investing in quality gear is an investment in your channel's success. But don't feel pressured to buy everything at once. Start with the essentials, upgrade as you grow, and most importantly, have fun creating awesome content that resonates with your audience! Now, I'd love to hear from you: What gear are you most excited to try out? What other questions do you have about video equipment? Leave a comment below – I'm here to help you every step of the way.

title: Hurco Alters Lathe Control to Match Mills
summary: Hurco engineers have altered the lathe control to match the mills, allowing machinists to jump from mill to lathe seamlessly.
body_text: For years, the control software on Hurco's lathes differed from the control software on Hurco's mills . No longer! Now engineers have altered the lathe control to match the mills, allowing machinists to jump from mill to lathe seamlessly. The difference in software was the result of the engineering process, and the fact that some of the background software on the lathes was provided by third-party developer MDSI . As you can imagine, these differences between the two otherwise seemingly similar controls resulted in quite the learning curve for existing Hurco mill users when learning to program and operate the not-so-similar lathe control, and vice versa. To begin changing the lathe control to become more like the mills, Hurco purchased MDSI in 2007. Although this acquisition provided much more control over the product and allowed more flexibility to make changes to the software, Hurco engineers were still limited by the old architecture of the previous platform and unable to fully integrate some of the Hurco features and benefits that the WinMax® software offered and had become so well loved by the Hurco mill users. In 2023, Hurco began releasing the latest Hurco lathe WinMax® software we refer to as version 11 (V11). This new version is 100% Hurco created software – both on the front end of the user interface, as well as the back end of the control software itself – replacing all the previously used third-party architecture. With V11, the user experience between both products is the same, and an operator can move between Hurco mill or lathe products with confidence. Not only has the addition of V11 made things more compatible, but it also provided the software architecture that will allow Hurco engineers to share feature and benefit ideas between both product lines when applicable. Hurco has always been responsive to feedback from our customers when it comes to enhancement suggestions on the milling products, and now we can begin to implement the suggestions we receive from lathe users as well. This is just another example of how Hurco works to provide machinists with the most user-friendly and powerful control on the market. title: Kenvue advances commitment to sun safety and education by collaborating with Walgreens and MRF
body_text: July 18, 2024 – Kenvue is advancing its commitment to educating adults and youth about the importance of practicing safe skin care and overall skin health. Beginning now with Ultraviolet (UV) Safety Month in July, the company’s Neutrogena brand is collaborating with Walgreens and the Melanoma Research Foundation (MRF) to equip families with the information they need to protect their skin from the sun by offering free skin cancer screenings and education on effective skincare products. “Summer is full of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors and create fun memories with friends and loved ones, but it also increases our skin’s exposure to harmful UV rays,” said Liz Pandya, Head of Public Health and Education, Kenvue*. “That’s why we’re proud to help arm families with the knowledge and resources they need to be sun safe every day.” In collaboration with Neutrogena, Walgreens is hosting SPF Fest, an outdoor interactive community-oriented event in Chicago featuring Neutrogena experts, products, and free skin cancer screenings provided by the MRF. According to the MRF, nearly 93% of cutaneous melanomas are related to excess UV exposure, and regular screenings are vital to help detect melanoma in its earliest stages. “We’re thrilled to work alongside Neutrogena and MRF to educate Chicagoans on the importance of protecting our skin during the long summer days spent in the sun,” said Heather Hughes, Group Vice President and General Merchandise Manager for Health, Wellness, Beauty, and Personal Care at Walgreens. “Customers outside of the Chicago area can always stop by their local Walgreens to consult with our Beauty and Wellness Consultants and Pharmacists for personalized sunscreen recommendations tailored to their individual needs.” “As the largest independent organization devoted to eradicating melanoma, the MRF is pleased to collaborate with its longstanding National Prevention Partner, Neutrogena, and Walgreens this UV Safety Month at the upcoming SPF Fest,” says MRF CEO Kyleigh LiPira. “Fostering patient education and promoting awareness around the importance of sun safety and prevention is integral to the MRF’s mission and we are elated to facilitate complimentary skin checks for the greater Chicago community.” Kenvue is also advancing skin protection education through its sponsorship of Young Minds Inspired , a leading provider of free educational outreach programs for learners of all ages. As part of the sponsorship, this fall, Young Minds Inspired will launch a free education program, Sun Safety for All, that teaches the basics of skin health through sun safety. Developed alongside experts in youth education and dermatology, the program is geared toward teachers, students, and families. It’s a turn-key program flexibly designed with digital and print resources to support ELA, Science & health curricula. “UV rays don’t stop as the summer winds down and it’s time to go back to school, and neither should protective skin care,” added Pandya. “By working with Young Minds Inspired, we’re making it fun and engaging to learn what it means to practice safe skin care. We hope that teachers and families embrace the program for a healthy start to the new school year.” “YMI, the leading provider of educational materials, is proud to collaborate with Kenvue to develop a sun care educational campaign that will engage millions of kids in grades 3rd through 8th and their families,” added Donald Lay, Managing Partner and Owner at YMI, Inc. “Our interactive print and digital content will educate and increase awareness about the effects of UV rays on the skin and the importance of consistent sun protection. Together, we can make a difference in protecting families and promoting overall well-being.” The Sun Safety for All program will begin as a pilot, with a rollout scheduled in 20 states timed for the back-to-school season. To learn more about Neutrogena’s collaborations in advancing skin health education or to set up an interview with Elizabeth Pandya, please contact media relations, Mike Stouber at mstoub01@kenvue.com. __________________________________________ *Elizabeth Pandya is an employee of Johnson & Johnson Consumer, Inc.

Top 50 Startup Investors in the United States Shizu’s list of 50 angel investors and VC funds that invest in startups based in the US. They rank investors based on the number of investments they made in companies from the US, and update the list every month. ‍ Searching for Active Investors During your investor research and outreach, keep in mind it’s good to look for investors who are actively investing - aka those who have dry powder. Otherwise, you could be targeting investors who may like your company, but don’t have the funds to make an investment at this time. It’s not that those couldn't be good connections down the line for a future raise, but those conversations shouldn’t take priority over those with investors ready to write you a check.Now, with great power comes great responsibility. ‍ Sort Investors By Investment Thesis As we recently covered , you want to find investors who match with your company across their investment stage, industry focus, and investment size for your current round of funding. Finta automatically analyzes your company and automatically suggests the most suitable investors from its database of 10,000+ investors. Research Warm Introductions It’s always best to also take the time to try and find a warm introduction! As Charlie O'Donnell, Partner and Founder of Brooklyn Bridge Ventures writes on his blog : “Perhaps the most unfair of all of these investor scorecard factors is when the founder is known to the investor — known people are de-risked.” ‍ Conclusion What’s something you should keep in mind while utilizing these lists? Remember - no mass emailing! Use the information included, and do your own research to segment out the investors that are the best fit for YOU before reaching out. You don’t want to waste an investor’s time, just like you’d be frustrated if they asked you to pitch, knowing your company wasn’t a good fit to begin with. There are some incredible resources curated and linked above, and we hope they help you on your fundraising journey. If you’re looking for more help in managing your fundraise, check out Finta as well!

body_text: Treatment adherence is crucial in achieving positive outcomes, yet despite its importance, non-adherence to prescribed treatments is a significant issue. Collaborative Care Management (CoCM) has emerged as a key solution to improving adherence rates, leveraging integrated approaches and advanced technologies to support patients more effectively. This blog explores how Collaborative Care Management models measure and enhance treatment adherence and provides recent, credible statistical data to support their impact. The Challenge of Treatment Adherence According to a report by the World Health Organization (WHO), approximately 50% of patients with chronic diseases in developed countries do not adhere to treatment recommendations. This non-adherence can lead to worsening health outcomes, increased hospitalizations, and higher healthcare costs. While adherence is notoriously difficult to track, CoCM offers many opportunities to measure and address adherence to treatment programs. *Treatment adherence refers to the extent to which patients follow their prescribed medical regimens, including medications, lifestyle changes, and follow-up appointments. The Power of Collaborative Care Management Collaborative Care Management offers a multifaceted approach to addressing the factors that influence treatment adherence. By bringing together primary care providers, behavioral health specialists, and care managers, CoCM fosters a patient-centric approach that prioritizes communication, shared decision-making, and individualized care plans. A meta-analysis published in the Annals of Internal Medicine found that CoCM interventions significantly improved adherence to medication and lifestyle recommendations for various chronic conditions, including diabetes, hypertension, and depression. These findings highlight the potential of CoCM to drive positive health outcomes. How Collaborative Care Improves Treatment Adherence Enhanced Communication and Coordination :some text Collaborative Care Management models facilitate better communication among healthcare providers, ensuring that all members of a patient's care team are informed and aligned. This coordinated approach helps in creating and maintaining consistent treatment plans. A study published in the National Library of Medicine found that patients receiving CoCM had a higher adherence rate to their treatment plans compared to those in traditional care settings. Integrated Behavioral Health :some text Addressing behavioral health issues is crucial for improving adherence, especially for patients with co-occurring mental health conditions. CoCM integrates behavioral health services into primary care, making it easier for patients to receive comprehensive support. According to a study published in the National Library of Medicine, the patients in CoCM programs were more likely to adhere to their medication regimens for depression and anxiety. Use of Collaborative Care Management Platforms :some text Leverage technology to measure and support adherence through reminders, educational materials, and easy access to healthcare providers. They also allow for the tracking of patient progress and early identification of potential adherence issues. A study by the National Library of Medicine found that implementing a collaborative care intervention for primary care patients with persistent depression led to better outcomes without increasing overall healthcare costs. Overcoming Barriers and Scaling Collaborative Care While Collaborative Care and Management platforms hold immense potential, challenges such as resource constraints, provider burnout, and system-level barriers may hinder their implementation. Addressing these issues requires constant efforts to build capacity, promote interdisciplinary collaboration, and advocate for policy changes that support proactive patient-centered care. By investing in Collaborative Care Management and leveraging the power of CoCM platforms, healthcare systems can improve treatment adherence and enhance patient outcomes, while offering a new revenue stream. Conclusion Improving treatment adherence is essential for enhancing health outcomes and reducing healthcare costs. Collaborative Care Management and CoCM platforms offer effective solutions by fostering better communication, integrating behavioral health, and leveraging technology. The statistical data underscores the significant positive impact these approaches have on adherence rates and overall patient health. By continuing to adopt and refine CoCM models, healthcare providers can ensure that patients receive the comprehensive support they need to follow their treatment plans and achieve better health outcomes.
